verse.verse_1: By oath of the heaven which contains the constellations.
verse.verse_2: And by oath of the Promised Day.
verse.verse_3: And by oath of the day that is a witness and by oath of a day in which the people present themselves.
verse.verse_4: Accursed be the People of the Ditch!
verse.verse_5: The people of the fuelled blazing fire.
verse.verse_6: When they were sitting at its edge.
verse.verse_7: And they themselves are witnesses to what they were doing to the Muslims!
verse.verse_8: And what did they dislike from the Muslims, except that the Muslims accepted faith in Allah the Most Honourable, the Most Praiseworthy?
verse.verse_9: To Him only belongs the kingship of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is a Witness over all things.
verse.verse_10: Indeed those who troubled the Muslim men and Muslim women, and then did not repent – for them is the punishment of hell, and for them is the punishment of fire.
verse.verse_11: Indeed those who believed and did good deeds – for them are Gardens beneath which rivers flow; this is the great success.
verse.verse_12: Indeed the seizure of your Lord is very severe.
verse.verse_13: Indeed it is He Who initiates and redoes.
verse.verse_14: And He only is the Oft Forgiving, the Beloved of His bondmen.
verse.verse_17: Did the story of the armies reach you?
verse.verse_18: (The armies of) Firaun and the tribe of Thamud.
verse.verse_19: In fact the disbelievers are in denial.
verse.verse_20: And Allah is after them, has them surrounded.
verse.verse_21: In fact it (what they deny) is the Noble Qur’an.
